description: Simulated gaussian data with no, one and several planted splits.
generator_code:
{
    n <- 600L
    d <- data.frame(x = rnorm(n), z1 = runif(n, 0, 10), z2 = factor(sample(c("a", "b", "c", "d"), n, 
        replace = TRUE)), z3 = factor(sample(paste0("L", 1:5), n, replace = TRUE), levels = paste0("L", 
        1:5), ordered = TRUE), z4 = as.numeric(sample(1:20, n, replace = TRUE)), z5 = factor(sample(c("u", 
        "v", "w"), n, replace = TRUE)))
    e <- rnorm(n)
    d$y_null <- 1 + 2 * d$x + e
    left <- d$z1 <= 5
    d$y_one <- ifelse(left, 1 + 2 * d$x, -1 + 0.5 * d$x) + e
    low3 <- as.integer(d$z3) <= 2L
    ac <- d$z2 %in% c("a", "c")
    b0 <- ifelse(d$z1 <= 4, ifelse(low3, 1, -1.5), ifelse(ac, 2, 2))
    b1 <- ifelse(d$z1 <= 4, ifelse(low3, 1, 1), ifelse(ac, -1, 1.5))
    d$y_multi <- b0 + b1 * d$x + e
    d$w <- sample(1:3, n, replace = TRUE)
    d$w0 <- d$w * as.integer(runif(n) > 0.1)
    d
}
